decisions.title: Use file-backed non-LLM goal records first
decisions.decision: Start with JSON and Markdown records before adding live integrations.
decisions.consequence: The Goal Tracking OS remains inspectable and useful without a model provider.

decisions.title: Do not stage unrelated deletion set
decisions.decision: This slice excludes pre-existing unstaged deletions.
decisions.consequence: Repository hygiene stays visible as a blocker instead of being hidden in a Goal Tracking commit.

decisions.title: Treat five-million-character request as an aggregate context ceiling
decisions.decision: Keep the rendered prompt bounded and load only source-linked chunks required by the selected goal.
decisions.consequence: Goal Tracking remains evidence-backed and maintainable without filler, duplicate source text, or inflated file counts.

decisions.title: Keep Enterprise Expansion V3 specification-only until implementation evidence exists
decisions.decision: Register all requested architecture, execution, validation, observability, design, AI, knowledge-graph, and long-term evolution terms with explicit ownership and evidence requirements, while preserving their specification maturity.
decisions.consequence: The registry can guide decomposition without falsely claiming live implementation, provider/model/plugin/MCP execution, background agents, or enterprise release readiness.

decisions.title: Interpret ten-year continuous development as session-based stewardship
decisions.decision: Represent the ten-year focus as ten planned annual phases with explicit continuation state, review cadences, metrics, stop conditions, and evidence requirements.
decisions.consequence: Future sessions can continue from a durable state without claiming hidden background execution, elapsed time, or unsupported future completion.
